scope: Isolated synthetic telephone control and rule AI with real MySQL/Redis. Host JVM only. No real SIP/RTP/PCM, paid model, production traffic or database failover qualification.

earlier_broad_unit_run.note: Full units and selected integration passed before the final heartbeat and drain-recovery changes; not full-suite evidence for the final source.

phases.P0: Read-only provider probe; correlated immutable terminal facts; ordered durable-inbox replay. Requires original outcome/billing proof, never an ended boolean alone.
phases.P1: Separate callback (2 in CPS, 4 in AI) and control (4) JDBC pools, AI realtime (4), analysis (1) and general (8 in this fixture). Control execution is bounded by its reservation. Ordinary speech receipts for locked answered/in_ai calls avoid the global resource mutex; other states/kinds roll back before platform-locked fallback. Playback 409 conflicts defer unchanged until correlated reconciliation; other failure limits and complete drain gates remain. Coalesced worker maintenance acquires identity before JDBC and commits heartbeat before bounded completed-receipt retention. Admission closure filters new dial claims out and permits only frozen-command recovery despite unhealthy new-admission feedback. Latency qualification remains determined by load results.
phases.P2: Commit and send each group of at most 100 before preparing later groups, preserving successful-prefix outcomes. Known rolled-back deadlock retries bounded to once. Durable quota authority cutover and async report projection remain unimplemented.
phases.P3: Optional standalone media JVM and authenticated RPC; static-provider configuration only. Profile authority RPC and real audio/restart continuity remain unqualified.
phases.P4: Automatic controller/database failover remains unimplemented and unqualified; single-controller guard is retained. User confirmed no target media/failover environment.
phases.P5: Functional checks and synthetic load recorded here; real-media and failover qualification unavailable.
